text.3:137: Systems have passed away before you. Do but travel in the land and see the nature of the consequence for those who did deny (the messengers).
text.4:26: Allah would explain to you and guide you by the examples of those who were before you, and would turn to you in mercy. Allah is Knower, Wise.
text.8:38: Tell those who disbelieve that if they cease (from persecution of believers) that which is past will be forgiven them; but if they return (thereto) then the example of the men of old hath already gone (before them, for a warning).
text.15:13: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.
text.17:77: (Such was Our) method in the case of those whom We sent before thee (to mankind), and thou wilt not find for Our method aught of power to change.
text.18:55: And naught hindereth mankind from believing when the guidance cometh unto them, and from asking forgiveness of their Lord unless (it be that they wish) that the judgment of the men of old should come upon them or (that) they should be confronted with the Doom.
text.33:38: There is no reproach for the Prophet in that which Allah maketh his due. That was Allah's way with those who passed away of old - and the commandment of Allah is certain destiny -
text.33:62: That was the way of Allah in the case of those who passed away of old; thou wilt not find for the way of Allah aught of power to change.
text.35:43: (Shown in their) behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil; and the evil plot encloseth but the men who make it. Then, can they expect aught save the treatment of the folk of old? Thou wilt not find for Allah's way of treatment any substitute, nor wilt thou find for Allah's way of treatment aught of power to change.
text.40:85: But their faith could not avail them when they saw Our doom. This is Allah's law which hath ever taken course for His bondmen. And then the disbelievers will be ruined.
text.48:23: It is the law of Allah which hath taken course aforetime. Thou wilt not find for the law of Allah aught of power to change.
